description: A safe macOS wrapper for the HomeClaw HomeKit CLI and stdio MCP server.

novel_features.name: HomeClaw CLI delegation
novel_features.description: Delegates commands to the installed HomeClaw macOS app without installing, symlinking, or changing HomeKit state.

novel_features.name: HomeClaw stdio MCP
novel_features.description: Runs the installed HomeClaw MCP server through a stable Printing Press command.
